title: Bind the inverse-error lower bound to its loss architecture
statement: Only for the star-only absorbing LOSS-flag architecture, no direct ground controls, fixed kappa and full operator norm ||A||<=a, the source proves T>=4 kappa (1-epsilon)^2/(a^2 epsilon). An upper bound on Re A alone is not a bound on full coupling speed. The resulting N^2/epsilon circuit allocation is sufficient in that architecture, not universal gate complexity or a fault-tolerance threshold. The later absorbing logical-output construction changes these hypotheses and has a separate exponential gate law.
